description: This is a PHP source file for a web interface page that facilitates adding port forwarding rules, including handling IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, form validation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address with '::' notation into an expanded array of segments.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if certain IPv6 address input fields are blank.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates IPv6 address parts into a string separated by a given separator.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address input is required based on certain conditions.

methods.name: ipv6_in_int
methods.description: Converts IPv6 address segments into an array of integers for comparison.

methods.name: isHex
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid hexadecimal number.

methods.name: validate_v6addr_pool
methods.description: Checks if one IPv6 address is within the valid range defined by start and end addresses.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Checks if IPv4 address input is required.
